🔎 SOLVE THE CASE 🕵️

Think you have what it takes to be a detective? 🔍

🗂️ Investigate mysterious cases
📱 Search phones, messages & hidden clues
💻 Examine CCTV footage and secret evidence
🧩 Connect clues and uncover the truth
👥 Play SOLO or with up to 4 friends
🚨 Question suspects and expose their lies

📁 CASE 001: THE MISSING GIRL

A 19-year-old girl has mysteriously disappeared. The suspects have secrets, the evidence doesn't add up, and someone is lying...

Can YOU figure out what really happened? 👀

⚠️ Look closely. Every detail matters.

⭐ Like & Favourite for NEW CASES coming soon!
